outcome: Retain the accepted serial renderer and remove ignored per-dispatch memoryBarrier calls. Archive the concurrent scheduler after no useful measured frame-time gain. No speed or energy improvement is claimed for the retained cleanup.

audit.computeEncoders: The ordinary path uses makeComputeCommandEncoder(); profiling uses a default MTLComputePassDescriptor. Both have serial dispatch semantics.
audit.resourceOrdering: All resources are directly bound, tracked device allocations. Serial dispatch ordering and tracked cross-pass resource synchronization preserve the existing graph.

removedCalls.scope: Default fused wave/foam mips, shared lighting cache disabled; excludes startup.

audit.productionChange: The renderer differs from the pre-audit source only by deleting the memoryBarrier call and replacing its comment. All native shaders and compute order are unchanged.

documentation.supports: Default serial compute dispatch and synchronization of directly bound tracked resources.
Default compute pass dispatch type is serial.

documentation.excerpt: Calling barrier on a serial encoder is allowed, but ignored.

ignoredCallComparison.decision: Remove ignored calls for simpler serial command encoding; timing comparisons do not establish a repeatable CPU/GPU gain.

limitations: The eight-frame capture checks initial generation and incremental reflection face refreshes, but does not exercise a later sky/sun refresh at the tested 30 Hz timestep.
No concurrent stage profiling is claimed: profiling intentionally falls back to the original serial scheduler.
concurrentCandidate.interpretation: Average GPU time changed by 0.19%, median by 0.15%, and average encoding-thread CPU time by 0.22%. Those runs did not establish a useful improvement, so the additional scheduler was not retained.

validation.fullSuite: zsh macos/test.sh completed successfully with ten PASS gates. Log: macos/build/synchronization-validation.log

limitations: One Apple M1 and software viewport targets; these checks do not establish every physical monitor or GPU generation.
The first ignored-call comparison improved average thread CPU time by 12.2%, while the stable-time comparison regressed by 4.7%; CPU differences are inconsistent and no CPU speedup is claimed.
Concurrent eight-frame image checks do not exercise a later sky/sun refresh; that scheduler is archived and excluded from the native app.
nextCandidates: Fuse SIM_EVOLVE with FFT_ROWS to avoid writing and rereading two spectrum buffers: 24 MiB of intermediate traffic per frame at six 256-by-256 cascades. Preserve the original float32 equations and verify row outputs plus final images before adoption.
